dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it isn't that big a deal...

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: *Sigh* It's because of people like you who mindlessly follow every new trend that we're losing the old ways! The actual ways of our ancestors!

dialogues.speaker: Ovsyannikov
dialogues.text: Fae nowadays have zero sense of propriety! Mark my words, at this rate, we're going to lose the ways of the Pale Star completely!
